{"claims":[{"claim_text":"DSA is committed to building democratic labor unions that empower and activate their rank and file members.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A DSLC supported by national staff and NPC resources will help educate DSAers on how to be effective rank and file activists.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Commission will work to develop resources on how members in unorganized workplaces can increase the collective power of individuals in their workplace, including how best to initiate union drives.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The DSLC will work to dispel the notion that workers ought to be pitted against each other along lines of nationality, race, gender, ability and sexuality.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The DSLC will prioritize the facilitation of a diverse but united workers’ movement.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The DLSC and labor branches should emphasize the contributions of immigrants, people of color, women, LGBTQIA+, and disabled comrades in the workplace and the labor movement.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"There is a deep consonance between labor struggles and other axes of the fight against oppression.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The DSLC will work to help the unemployed.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"A commitment to full employment through a job guarantee, where anyone willing and able to work can find suitable paid employment, helps to build the labor movement from the bottom up.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Without a ‘reserve army of the unemployed’, capitalists are forced to compete for workers, materially improving the lives of all.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
